Phantom Blade Zero · Ch. 5 Mandate Encampment · Perfect Transcensions
Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation
With the Chief Disciple at their head, the seven wield their swords as one, arrayed in the shape of the Northern Dipper, hence the name Seven-Star Formation. After Perfect Transcension, they became bound by Sha-Chi, their movements in attack and retreat perfectly synchronized.
Both phases are in the Year of the Snake trailer and the official demo walkthrough.
Key points
How? Kill the six weaker fighters first, and parry through phase one. In phase two he is tied above the stage. After a dash, a blue attack.
Drop? The Swordsman's Summon and the Training Grounds Key.
Where you fight: Right by the Tower Rear Exit Bell (Mandate Encampment)Nearest Bell: Tower Rear ExitApproximate: distances are estimated from the game data, and the map painting is not to scale.Open this spot on the map →

How to beat this fight
One chief and six weaker fighters. Kill the six first, and parry through the first phase.
In the second phase he is tied above the stage. After a dash, a blue attack. In a three-swing string, the third swing is blue.
When he is in the air and sheds many small red pieces, dodge each one as it arrives. Standing in them kills you in seconds.
He drops the Swordsman’s Summon and the Training Grounds Key.
Attacks & how to counter
Attacks seen 9
These labels are our plain descriptions; the game has published no move names.
Formation assaults Seven swordsmen alternate coordinated group assaults and single strikes.
Surround thrust Whole group converges in a coordinated thrust from all directions.
Screen of disciples He dodges and calls ordinary disciples in front of him to attack.
Form-up group attack With many of them alive they form up and attack together often.
Encircling strike The white-robed disciples close in around the player and strike at once; blue arcs flash where the blades meet. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 0:50.
Red line across the arena A thin red line stretches horizontally between the figures by the burning tower. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 1:00.
Group rush The whole group rushes the player at once while the player meets them with a red-edged blade. Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 17:23.
Thin red thread A fine red thread runs across the yard from a disciple as the player strikes. Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 18:19.
Flank from behind White-robed disciples circle behind the player to ambush. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1Qmf8YbE6x, 01:49).
How to counter 8
Thin the disciples quickly so they cannot heal him.
Kill enough followers, or he heals himself.
Look for gaps between their attacks and hit the core, the Chief Disciple, directly.
A perfectly timed dodge leaps the group thrust.
When swarmed, a leaping Bashpole smash sends everyone flying.
When he spends his health keeping three followers alive, punish him (the writer used a thrown Seamless Death barrage)
White Serpent & Crimson Viper: the long blade's wide spins suit being surrounded, and the short blade triggers executions from range to clear the field fast.
After the Chief Disciple drains a junior disciple, that disciple can be executed. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1TufUYME4N, 02:45).
Location, drops & connected quests
The final boss of the 2025 demo.
On-screen objective just before the fight: "Justice Camp — Reach the deeper part of Justice Camp.". On screen in the 2025 demo walkthrough, 16:37.
Drops The Swordsman's Summon and the Training Grounds Key.
Where, in detail
Both videos show an open, muddy yard ringed by wooden watchtowers, one of them burning, under a smoky sky.
Phases and mechanics
Chief Disciple’s Fallen HopeThe second phase of the Chief Disciple fight, a marionette. Red Wraith, if left unfinished, returns to join this last phase.
Two phases: the seven-swordsman formation, then a marionette phase under a new name (Chief Disciple's Fallen Hope)
Mechanic: as followers fall, he spends his health to keep at least three alive.
Mechanic: each warrior has its own health bar.
Phase change: three disciples leap onto the towers and puppet the others with threads.
Raised arms in unison. Several disciples raise their arms together in front of the burning tower. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 2:10.
Blue flash. A bright blue star-shaped flash appears at a disciple as the group closes in. Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 17:44.
Dodge executions. Disciples lean back to stay out of execution range. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1Qmf8YbE6x, 01:35).
Rope heal. A disciple at the back heals the Chief Disciple with a rope. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1Qmf8YbE6x, 02:01).
Revives disciples. The Chief Disciple raises fallen disciples again with blood. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1Qmf8YbE6x, 02:15).

Launch-build boss dossier (29 October 2026)
“With the Chief Disciple at their head, the seven wield their swords as one, arrayed in the shape of the Northern Dipper, hence the name Seven-Star Formation. After Perfect Transcension, they became bound by Sha-Chi, their movements in attack and retreat perfectly synchronized. These seven prided themselves on their integrity, devoted to punishing evil, upholding justice, and honing their swordsmanship, never seeking to contend with others. Yet the Chief Disciple fell in love with a woman from an evil sect, violating the Mandate’s rules. Though his swordsmanship was peerless and his many achievements had long made amends, the alliance still refused to promote him and repeatedly marginalized him. He merely laughed it off and bore every injustice. He would not betray the woman he loved or his sect. Between the irreconcilable paths of "righteousness" and "evil," he sought a path he could follow with a clear conscience. Yet he often felt he owed too much to the junior disciples who had followed him all these years. They never blamed their senior brother, instead burning with indignation over the injustices he suffered. Then that incident... shattered their last respect for the alliance’s upper ranks. They realized that meekly yielding only made them pawns to be used and trampled at will. Consumed by resentment, they underwent Perfect Transcension. The alliance used this to expel them, making them even less known in the Wulin, especially their Chief Disciple, the foremost swordsman who led the formation.”Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation — Phantom Blade Zero in-game boss dossier
“On the high platform, three disciples catch a red thread on their sword tips and draw the Chief Disciple up with it, leaving him hanging upside down in midair. Pulled by the strings, he swings the blade in his hands, like a puppet trying to break free of its strings; like a wraith, he sprays countless razor-sharp red threads from the black hollows of his face, winding and slicing through the air like tears of blood. He once loved a woman from an evil sect. The Mandate’s upper ranks would not tolerate their love, and with a single order, they tore the lovers apart. The Chief Disciple had known little beyond the sword formation. What did he know of schemes and intrigue? For the first time in his life, he clumsily defied his sect. In return, he could only watch helplessly as the woman he loved was tortured and left covered in wounds. Even his peerless sword formation could not protect the one he wanted to protect. Once his heart was broken, there was little left he feared losing. He entrusted everything he had left to the strings. And what if he looked like a puppet hanging upside down? At least the strings of that puppet would be held in their own hands.”Chief Disciple, Sword of Despair — Phantom Blade Zero in-game boss dossier
Connected weapon: Swordsman’s Summon.
Key facts
Boss · Bounty
Chief Disciple of the Seven Stars
Name sources → for Chief Disciple of the Seven Stars
The formation. He leads six other warriors. His followers heal him at the cost of their own health.
First shown: The Year of the Snake trailer of January 2025 (its own name plate at 0:42 reads “Chief Disciple of the Seven Stars”) and the 2025 demo, where he is the final boss. A Chinese report describes what appears to be the same fight in that trailer, so it is the same boss.
Second phase: Chief Disciple’s Fallen Hope

In the frame above Under a red sky, a figure in a straw hat faces a figure hanging in the air before a burning tower.
Chief Disciple’s Fallen Hope attacks and how to counter
Attacks seen 12
These labels are our plain descriptions; the game has published no move names.
Erratic marionette Sways erratically in mid-air; his patterns become frantic and harder to read.
Thread barrage Rushes you with melee attacks while dangling, and throws a screen-filling barrage of threads.
Pendulum swings Pendulum swings on high red lines over a wide area; chasing him wastes your rhythm and damage.
Tracking red thread Tracking red thread.
Swing-in on a thread The hanging figure swings in from the tower on a red thread straight at the player. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 3:20.
Inverted overhead pass He flips upside-down through the air above the player, trailing red lines. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 3:40.
Fan of white threads High in the air, a burst of thin white lines fans out around him. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 3:53.
Red line volley A fan of about fifteen straight red lines shoots from the airborne figure across the arena past the player. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 4:10.
Criss-cross web Many red and white lines criss-cross in the air right above the player. Seen in the Year of the Snake trailer at 5:00.
Travels along the red lines He moves through the air along red lines near the burning tower. Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 19:35.
Threads across the yard Red threads cut across the yard from both sides while the player crouches low. Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 21:07.
Feints Phase-two moves add feints. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1Qmf8YbE6x, 02:53).
How to counter 6
Perfect blocks and perfect dodges trigger Ghoststep counters that drain his Sha-Chi fast and can knock him out of the air; a plain block only costs your own Sha-Chi, so mastering the perfect block is the key to this phase.
In the trailer the player uses the lunge of a giant axe to dodge the tracking red thread and hits him as he drops; the same source notes the axe is not invincible while it is active.
Each retry starts at the beginning of the marionette phase.
Writer's finish: down the Red Wraith first, survive his enraged counterattack, then cut his strings.
In the trailer the giant axe cuts the airborne Chief Disciple down. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1TufUYME4N, 05:05).
In the trailer Soul cuts the three red threads holding him up. A Bilibili creator’s claim (BV1TufUYME4N, 05:11).
Where Chief Disciple’s Fallen Hope is fought and what it drops
Same arena as phase 1 (burning-tower yard), now lit red (2025 demo 18:51). Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 18:51.
Drops The Swordsman's Summon and the Training Grounds Key.
Phases and mechanics
This is phase 2 of the Chief Disciple fight; dying restarts at the start of this phase.
Two-on-one with Red Wraith. Both plates are up; Red Wraith and the threaded figure attack the player together. Seen in the 2025 demo walkthrough at 20:15.
